question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Efficient**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is '**Efficient**' which means being productive without wasting time or effort. (समय या प्रयास बर्बाद किए बिना उत्पादक बनना) • **Example**: *The new process is highly efficient, saving both time and resources.* • The word is an adjective and is pronounced as "ih-fish-uhnt." • It is derived from the Latin word 'efficiens' meaning 'producing'. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Concurently**: The correct spelling is '**Concurrently**' which means at the same time. (एक ही समय पर) • **Strateigy**: The correct spelling is '**Strategy**' which means a plan of action to achieve a goal. (किसी लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए कार्य योजना) • **Prodactivity**: The correct spelling is '**Productivity**' which means the rate at which goods or services are produced. (वह दर जिस पर वस्तुओं या सेवाओं का उत्पादन किया जाता है) 3d:T9ef, The correct answer is: **Pilgrimmage**
